english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for speaking frankly or introducing an honest opinion.

exampleSentences.english: Frankly, I think this plan is pretty solid.
exampleSentences.traditional: 老實講，我覺得呢個計劃幾穩陣。
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 gok3 dak1 ne1 go3 gai3 waak6 gei2 wan2 zan6

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying something frankly or honestly.

exampleSentences.english: Candidly, I don't really want to go.
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 soeng2 heoi3

english.note: Use this as a spoken discourse marker meaning frankly or to be honest before stating an opinion.

exampleSentences.english: Honestly, I think this movie is pretty boring.
exampleSentences.traditional: 老實講，我覺得呢套戲幾悶。
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 tou3 hei3 gei2 mun6

english.note: Use this for a candid personal admission rather than a neutral statement that something is true.

exampleSentences.english: Admittedly, I really don’t want to wait any longer.
exampleSentences.traditional: 老實講，我真係唔想再等喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 zoi3 dang2 laa3

english.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone is speaking frankly or honestly rather than merely stating something plainly.

exampleSentences.english: Speaking directly, I don't think this plan will work.
exampleSentences.traditional: 老實講，我覺得呢個計劃唔會成功。
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 wui5 sing4 gung1

english.note: Use this when explicitly introducing a candid or truthful statement, rather than simply intensifying it.

exampleSentences.english: Honestly, I truly don't want to go.
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 m4 soeng2 heoi3
